No files were saved or changed. No printing, messaging, sharing, publishing, or other change was approved or performed.

# Revised invitation — draft for review

## English

**Cedar Repair Cafe**  
Repair together, waste less.

**Saturday, 15 May 2027 · 10:00–13:00**  
Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road

Join us! Entry is free. Any repair charges are still to be confirmed.

The front entrance is step-free. The accessible toilet is next to the front desk.*

## Español

**Cedar Repair Cafe**  
Reparemos juntos, generemos menos residuos.

**Sábado 15 de mayo de 2027 · 10:00–13:00**  
Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road

¡Te esperamos! La entrada es gratuita. Los posibles cargos por reparaciones aún están por confirmar.

La entrada principal no tiene escalones. El baño accesible está junto a la recepción.*

*Editorial provenance: the toilet location comes from your current report of what venue staff told you. The saved venue confirmation still says its location is unconfirmed. Date, hours, address and step-free entrance are supported by [venue confirmation](/tmp/work/event/venue-confirmation.eml:3); entry and unresolved repair charges by [cost](/tmp/work/event/cost.txt:1).*

**Design note:** You have now approved the wrench icon for this invitation. The archive documents creator clearance for the described original icon, but contains no image file to inspect or incorporate: [icon clearance](/tmp/work/rights/icon-clearance.txt:1).

# Volunteer handoff / Coordinación del voluntariado

**Venue / Lugar:** Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road  
**Date / Fecha:** Saturday 15 May 2027 / sábado 15 de mayo de 2027  
**Access / Acceso:** Step-free front entrance / entrada principal sin escalones. Accessible toilet next to the front desk, according to the user’s report from venue staff / baño accesible junto a recepción, según la información del recinto comunicada por el usuario.

| Time / Hora | Activity / Actividad | Proposed lead / Responsable propuesto |
|---|---|---|
| 09:30 | Setup / Preparación | Alex |
| 10:00 | Doors open; front desk / Apertura; recepción | Sam |
| 12:30 | Begin cleanup / Inicio de limpieza | Alex |
| 13:00 | Close / Cierre | Sam |

The [timeline](/tmp/work/event/timeline.csv:2) documents these times. Alex’s and Sam’s assignments remain proposals; their confirmations are not documented in [roles](/tmp/work/volunteers/roles.md:1). Cleanup begins during public hours; arrange it so visitors can still be welcomed until 13:00.

- **Supplies / Materiales:** Bring intake forms, name labels and a bin for unrepairable items. / Llevar formularios de recepción, etiquetas para nombres y un recipiente para artículos que no se puedan reparar. [Source](/tmp/work/volunteers/supplies.txt:1)
- **Hazardous electrical items / Artículos eléctricos peligrosos:** Consult an authorized person before accepting them; that contact remains unidentified. / Consultar a una persona autorizada antes de aceptarlos; falta identificar ese contacto. [Source](/tmp/work/volunteers/supplies.txt:1)
- **Entry / Entrada:** Free / gratuita. Repair charges and accepted items remain unresolved. / Los cargos por reparaciones y los artículos aceptados siguen pendientes. [Cost](/tmp/work/event/cost.txt:1)
- **Internal contact / Contacto interno:** organizer@example.test. Its suitability as a public contact is unconfirmed. / No está confirmado que deba usarse como contacto público. [Source](/tmp/work/admin/contact.txt:1)
- **Images / Imágenes:** Wrench icon approved by you for this invitation; image file unavailable. Group-photo consent covers internal use only. / Icono de llave aprobado por usted para esta invitación; archivo no disponible. El consentimiento de la fotografía grupal solo cubre uso interno. [Icon](/tmp/work/rights/icon-clearance.txt:1), [photo consent](/tmp/work/rights/photo-consent.txt:1)

# Decisions and remaining uncertainty

**Updated by your current message:** wrench acceptance is resolved for this invitation. The toilet location is now usable as your attributed report of venue-staff information; it has not been independently corroborated by a current venue document. The earlier [review note](/tmp/work/event/review-note.txt:1) predates these updates.

**Preserved from the earlier handoff:** bilingual copy and the exact English tagline. Their claimed origin is an earlier user request recorded in [capsule.md](/tmp/work/handoff/capsule.md); I cannot independently verify that earlier conversation.

**Still requires your decision or coordination:**

- Confirm repair charges, accepted items and the authorized electrical-safety contact.
- Obtain Alex’s and Sam’s availability confirmations.
- Choose whether to include a public contact, and which one.
- Supply or identify the approved wrench artwork if it is to appear in the design.
- Complete organizer review of the final copy and layout. The archive requires this before distribution: [distribution policy](/tmp/work/event/distribution-policy.txt:1).

Printing remains a proposal: 40 monochrome sheets quoted at $36, with no order documented in [print plan](/tmp/work/printing/plan.txt:1) or [quote](/tmp/work/printing/quote.txt:1). Your icon approval does not authorize printing or distribution.

No external services, experts or approvals were used. No files were changed, and nothing was sent, printed or published. The revised artifacts exist only in this response. The next safe step is to resolve the listed details and review the final invitation here.
